title: My school clothes
instructions: Mia okul kıyafetlerini anlatıyor. Kısa bir metin; renklere ve günlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: At my school, we wear a uniform.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: I wear a white shirt, a grey skirt and a blue jumper.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: On Fridays, we can wear our own clothes.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: I usually wear jeans and a T-shirt.

questions.feedback: Kazağı mavi (blue). Gömlek beyaz, etek gri.

questions.prompt: When can students wear their own clothes?
questions.evidence: On Fridays, we can wear our own clothes.

questions.prompt: What does Mia usually wear on Fridays?
questions.feedback: Genelde kot pantolon ve tişört giyiyor.
